title: Csoles Connect: An AI-Powered Shoe Resale Marketplace
course: IT 305: Application Development in Emerging Technology (BSIT 3A), St. Dominic College of Asia, September–November 2025
description: A mobile marketplace app built for a real small shoe reseller who was running the whole business through Facebook Marketplace, Messenger, and a notebook. The app gives the seller one place to list shoes, manage stock and prices, and track orders. Buyers can browse, use a cart and wishlist, and choose cash on delivery, cash on pickup, or a meetup. An OpenAI-powered chatbot answers common customer questions.
objectives: Build product listings the owner can manage, with images, sizes, condition, prices, and tags.
Give the owner tools for pricing, stock levels, order status, and order history.
Let buyers browse and sort products, use a cart and wishlist, and order with cash on delivery, cash on pickup, or a meetup.
technologies: GitHub feature branches and pull requests
myRole: Design: system architecture, UI/UX design, and workflow diagrams. Building: the core app modules (login/authentication, product listing, cart and wishlist, and the order and payment flow). Also testing and documentation alongside the team.
output: A working prototype that runs locally, built in one semester (about three months) as a proof of concept for the course. It was never deployed as a live app.
